findings.title: Stage-1 claim-uncited 95.8% decomposed: 26.6% miscounted real citations + structurally-dead mtime window (54% of population is immutable April-era corpus) + unfiltered review surface (58% of uncited residue is non-repo-state prose)
findings.description: Directive-commissioned diagnosis of the perpetual Stage-1 RED. Three measurement defects and one real adoption gap, quantified from the full 2104-paragraph population plus a 90-item stratified hand sample: (1) 559 flagged paragraphs (26.6%) carry real file:anchor citations in formats strict CITATION_RE rejects — 94.0% resolve to existing files, 82.7% file+anchor. (2) The 14-day mtime window is dead: workspace-sync audits from a fresh clone, so checkout mtimes pass all 1130 files every cycle; era split by in-document dates is 2026-04:1145 / 05:547 / 06:322 / 07:86 / 08:4 — 96% immutable legacy. (3) The curmudgeon-review surface (98.5% of population) has no claim-shape filter; sampled uncited residue splits 58% over-caught (external-science argumentation, editorial judgment) vs 42% genuine repo-state claims that should cite. (4) Recent-30d behavior: 92.3% strict-uncited but 57% of those carry near-miss cites — partial organic adoption the checker cannot see. Full evidence + quoted examples in (monitor/tinker/proposals/PROP-147-stage1-claim-uncited-mixed-recalibration.json).
